summary_1line: Sakuntala’s son is divinely affirmed as Dushmanta’s heir, becoming Bharata; the narrative then shifts into the sacred genealogy leading to Yayati and Puru.

image_candidates.scene_text: A disembodied celestial voice echoes above the royal court as Dushmanta sits among priests and ministers while Sakuntala’s child stands before him.
King Dushmanta embraces the young boy Bharata, smelling his head affectionately while Brahmanas bless and bards praise in the court.
The mighty king Bharata rides in a chariot whose thunderous wheels roll across the earth as conquered kings bow before him.
